versions.content: {DRAFT} Valid cross cluster transition A WdgMCrossClusterTransition is only valid in following configurations:  from a WdgMCheckpoint to a WdgMTransitionProxy  from a WdgMTransitionProxy to a WdgMCheckpoint  from a WdgMTransitionProxy to another WdgMTransitionProxy (in Host Software Cluster only)  from a WdgMTransitionProxy to the identical WdgMTransitionProxy (in Applicative Software Cluster only for the case that no WdgMCheckpoint has to be reached in the Applicative Software Cluster), or  from a WdgMCheckpoint to a WdgMCheckpoint (in case the cross cluster transition graph is entirely described with WdgMCrossClusterTransition containers). Hereby the “from” is configured with the WdgMCrossClusterTransitionSourceRef, and the “to” is given by the WdgMCrossClusterTransitionDestRef.
